ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, $AB$ is the diameter of $\odot O$, and the chord $CD \perp AB$ at point $E$, $\angle CDB=30^\circ$, $CD=2\sqrt{3}$. Find the area of the shaded figure.
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
Solution: As shown in the figure, connect $BC$\\
$\because \angle CDB=30^\circ$\\
$\therefore \angle COB=60^\circ$\\
$\because OC=OB$\\
$\therefore \triangle OBC$ is an equilateral triangle\\
$\because CE\perp OB$\\
$\therefore OE=BE$\\
$\because CE=DE$, $\angle OEC=\angle BED$\\
$\therefore \triangle OCE\cong \triangle BDE$\\
$\therefore {S}_{\text{shaded}}={S}_{\text{sector} OBC}=\frac{n\pi {r}^{2}}{360}=\frac{60^\circ \cdot \pi \cdot {2}^{2}}{360}=\boxed{\frac{2\pi }{3}}$

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the figure: In the figure there is circle O, AB is a horizontal diameter, and O is on AB; on the right side there is a vertical chord CD, intersecting AB at E, and CD is perpendicular to AB; the figure connects radius OC and line segment DB; the shaded part consists of the upper segment region CEB and the lower triangle EDB. Then reason: Because ∠CDB=30° is an inscribed angle, the arc it subtends is CB, so the corresponding central angle ∠COB=2∠CDB=60°. Also OC=OB are radii, so △OBC is an equilateral triangle. Since AB passes through the center O and CD⊥AB, the perpendicular from the center to a chord bisects the chord, so CE=DE. Also in equilateral triangle OBC, CE is the altitude from C to OB, so it also bisects OB, hence OE=BE. Thus right triangles △OCE and △BDE satisfy CE=DE, OE=BE, and the included angles are both right angles, so the two triangles are congruent and have equal areas. Shaded area = upper segment region CEB + △BDE, and upper segment region CEB = sector OBC - △OCE; since △BDE and △OCE have equal areas, the shaded area is equal to the area of sector OBC. From CD=2√3 and CE=DE, get CE=√3. The side length of equilateral triangle OBC is radius r, and its height CE=(√3/2)r, so (√3/2)r=√3, giving r=2. The central angle of sector OBC is 60°, and the area is (60/360)πr²=(1/6)π·2²=2π/3.

method.CoT_raw:
先描述图像：图中是圆 O，AB 是水平直径，O 在 AB 上；右侧有一条竖直弦 CD，与 AB 交于 E，且 CD 垂直 AB；图中连有半径 OC 和线段 DB；阴影部分由上方的弓形区域 CEB 与下方三角形 EDB 组成。
再推理：因为 ∠CDB=30° 是圆周角，所对弧为 CB，所以对应的圆心角 ∠COB=2∠CDB=60°。又 OC=OB 为半径，因此 △OBC 是等边三角形。由于 AB 经过圆心 O 且 CD⊥AB，圆心到弦的垂线平分弦，所以 CE=DE。又在等边三角形 OBC 中，CE 是从 C 到 OB 的高，因此也平分 OB，故 OE=BE。于是直角三角形 △OCE 与 △BDE 满足 CE=DE、OE=BE，且夹角均为直角，所以两三角形全等，面积相等。阴影面积 = 上方弓形区域 CEB + △BDE，而上方弓形区域 CEB = 扇形 OBC - △OCE；由于 △BDE 与 △OCE 面积相等，所以阴影面积等于扇形 OBC 的面积。
由 CD=2√3 且 CE=DE，得 CE=√3。等边三角形 OBC 的边长为半径 r，其高 CE=(√3/2)r，所以 (√3/2)r=√3，得 r=2。扇形 OBC 的圆心角为 60°，面积为 (60/360)πr²=(1/6)π·2²=2π/3。

method.method_draft: Use coordinates and compute the shaded area directly. From the image, place O at the origin, AB on the x-axis, B=(r,0), and the vertical chord CD as x=e with C=(e,h), D=(e,-h), E=(e,0). The shaded region is the upper area under the circle from x=e to x=r plus the lower right triangle EDB. From the text CD=2√3, so h=√3. Since ∠CDB=30° is between vertical DC and segment DB, the horizontal-to-vertical ratio in right triangle D E B gives tan 30°=(r-e)/h, hence r-e=1. Because C lies on the circle, e²+h²=r². Substitute h=√3 and r=e+1 to get e²+3=(e+1)², so e=1 and r=2. Now compute the upper shaded part as ∫ from 1 to 2 of √(4-x²) dx = 2π/3−√3/2. The lower triangle EDB has area 1/2·ED·EB=1/2·√3·1=√3/2. Adding them gives 2π/3.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中是一圆，AB 为水平直径，O 在 AB 上为圆心；右侧有一条竖直弦 CD，与 AB 垂直交于 E；C 在上方、D 在下方、B 在右端。灰色阴影由两部分组成：上方在竖线 CD 到右端 B 之间、圆弧 CB 下方且 AB 上方的区域，以及下方三角形 EDB。推理：按坐标法，取 O=(0,0)，AB 为 x 轴，B=(r,0)，弦 CD 为 x=e，故 C=(e,h)、D=(e,-h)、E=(e,0)。由 CD=2√3 得 h=√3。∠CDB=30° 是竖直 DC 与 DB 的夹角，在直角三角形 DEB 中，tan30°=(r-e)/h，所以 r-e=√3/√3=1。又 C 在圆 x²+y²=r² 上，因此 e²+h²=r²。代入 h=√3 且 r=e+1，得 e²+3=(e+1)²，解得 e=1，r=2。上方阴影面积为 ∫[1,2] √(4-x²) dx = 2π/3 - √3/2。下方三角形 EDB 面积为 (1/2)·ED·EB=(1/2)·√3·1=√3/2。两部分相加，阴影面积为 2π/3。

solver_metadata.cot_raw: 图像描述：图中是一圆，AB 为水平直径，O 在 AB 上为圆心；右侧有一条竖直弦 CD，与 AB 垂直交于 E；C 在上方、D 在下方、B 在右端。灰色阴影由两部分组成：上方在竖线 CD 到右端 B 之间、圆弧 CB 下方且 AB 上方的区域，以及下方三角形 EDB。推理：按坐标法，取 O=(0,0)，AB 为 x 轴，B=(r,0)，弦 CD 为 x=e，故 C=(e,h)、D=(e,-h)、E=(e,0)。由 CD=2√3 得 h=√3。∠CDB=30° 是竖直 DC 与 DB 的夹角，在直角三角形 DEB 中，tan30°=(r-e)/h，所以 r-e=√3/√3=1。又 C 在圆 x²+y²=r² 上，因此 e²+h²=r²。代入 h=√3 且 r=e+1，得 e²+3=(e+1)²，解得 e=1，r=2。上方阴影面积为 ∫[1,2] √(4-x²) dx = 2π/3 - √3/2。下方三角形 EDB 面积为 (1/2)·ED·EB=(1/2)·√3·1=√3/2。两部分相加，阴影面积为 2π/3。

raw_record.original_question: As shown in the figure, $AB$ is the diameter of $\odot O$, and the chord $CD \perp AB$ at point $E$, $\angle CDB=30^\circ$, $CD=2\sqrt{3}$. Find the area of the shaded figure.
raw_record.answer:
Solution: As shown in the figure, connect $BC$\\
$\because \angle CDB=30^\circ$\\
$\therefore \angle COB=60^\circ$\\
$\because OC=OB$\\
$\therefore \triangle OBC$ is an equilateral triangle\\
$\because CE\perp OB$\\
$\therefore OE=BE$\\
$\because CE=DE$, $\angle OEC=\angle BED$\\
$\therefore \triangle OCE\cong \triangle BDE$\\
$\therefore {S}_{\text{shaded}}={S}_{\text{sector} OBC}=\frac{n\pi {r}^{2}}{360}=\frac{60^\circ \cdot \pi \cdot {2}^{2}}{360}=\boxed{\frac{2\pi }{3}}$
raw_record.final_cot:
First describe the figure: In the figure there is circle O, AB is a horizontal diameter, and O is on AB; on the right side there is a vertical chord CD, intersecting AB at E, and CD is perpendicular to AB; the figure connects radius OC and line segment DB; the shaded part consists of the upper segment region CEB and the lower triangle EDB.
Then reason: Because ∠CDB=30° is an inscribed angle, the arc it subtends is CB, so the corresponding central angle ∠COB=2∠CDB=60°. Also OC=OB are radii, so △OBC is an equilateral triangle. Since AB passes through the center O and CD⊥AB, the perpendicular from the center to a chord bisects the chord, so CE=DE. Also in equilateral triangle OBC, CE is the altitude from C to OB, so it also bisects OB, hence OE=BE. Thus right triangles △OCE and △BDE satisfy CE=DE, OE=BE, and the included angles are both right angles, so the two triangles are congruent and have equal areas. Shaded area = upper segment region CEB + △BDE, and upper segment region CEB = sector OBC - △OCE; since △BDE and △OCE have equal areas, the shaded area is equal to the area of sector OBC.
From CD=2√3 and CE=DE, get CE=√3. The side length of equilateral triangle OBC is radius r, and its height CE=(√3/2)r, so (√3/2)r=√3, giving r=2. The central angle of sector OBC is 60°, and the area is (60/360)πr²=(1/6)π·2²=2π/3.
